[b]****Changes****
[/b]
[list]
[*]Exchanged all of Abigail's Sprites and Portraits to BriAtCookiebox
[*]Replaced all "Abigail"s in dialogue with "Bri"
[*]Exchanged all of Haley's Sprites and Portraits to UmiKyoku
[*]Replaced all "Haley"s in dialogue with "Umi"
[*]Exchanged all of Evelyn's Sprites and Portraits to MomAtCookiebox
[*]Replaced all "Evelyn"s in dialogue with "MamaCookie"
[*]Exchanged all of Leah's Sprites and Portraits to CatNaps
[*]Replaced all "Leah"s in dialogue with "Catto"
[*]Replaced "Straw Hat" with "Bunny Ears"
[*]Replaced "Good Ol' Cap" with "Umi's Bow"
[*]Replaced "Abigail Portrait" with "Bri Portrait"
[*]Replaced "Haley Portrait" with "Umi Portrait"
[*]Replaced "Leah Portrait" with "Catto Portrait"
[*]Replaced "Leah's Sculpture" with "Catto's Sculpture"
[*]Added special voice lines when conditions are met
[/list]
[b]****Voice Line Conditions****[/b]

[list]
[*]Must be married to either Umi, Bri, or Catto
[*]Give gift to Bri/Umi/Catto when they are located inside the FarmHouse or outside on the Farm
[/list]

Manifest.Name: BriSkinUltimate
Manifest.Description: This mod changes the appearance of Abigail, Haley, Evelyn, and Leah to the corresponding characters: BriAtCookiebox, Umi Kyoku, MomAtCookiebox, and CatNaps.
Manifest.Author: Programmer: samhead, Artist: @ChrisPixelArt on Twitter, Bug Tester: MrsDinoMunster
